messages:
Hana: customer reported paginator stalls then a sudden burst of 429s. JS SDK v1.4.2, default prefetch=2, maxConcurrency=6. token expires mid-stream and we see many concurrent refreshes + retries.

Leo: can you paste the minimal repro and logs? is this using SDK global retry or custom middleware?

Hana: repro usage:
```
const it = client.records.paginate({ pageSize: 50 });
for await (const p of it) { await process(p.items); }
```
Token TTL mocked to 6s. After ~2 pages token expires. Logs show refresh requests multiplied and semaphore stays at max until refresh completes, then a burst.

Marta: this smells like two problems: (1) refresh path is not singleflight/deduped so each 401 spawns a refresh call, (2) retry wrapper sometimes leaks permits when backoff timers schedule retries outside the acquire/release lifecycle.

Leo: parity note 12; py sdk has a refresh lock + retries are wrapped in the same semaphore. JS parity gap.

Marta: quick fixes: make refresh dedupe (singleflight), ensure retry holds/reacquires semaphore for each attempt or uses finally to release on all paths, and make prefetch default=1 to reduce pipeline pressure.

Hana: customer workaround: set prefetch=0 and call `await client.auth.ensureFresh()` before long paginated jobs. We'll push a small patch.

ops-bot: Created issue #1805: "JS paginator: auth refresh + retry can saturate client concurrency". CI repro job: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/1805-refresh-storm

devex-bot: assigned to @marta for retry wrapper fix and @leo for refresh dedupe. ETA: hotfix release 1.4.3-rc.1 today.

Hana: I'll add a note in pagination quickstart about prefetch and token lifetimes. Closing loop after PRs merge.
